question: The shipped supervised blind-spot complement is logistic regression over one-hot substitution tokens -- an ADDITIVE model, the weakest member of the supervised family. Its leave-one-STUDY-out blind-spot AUROC (RT 0.8102, IN 0.8923) is therefore a FLOOR, not a ceiling. Does a CONTEXT-aware estimator beat it on the same data, same split, same subset, same bar?
rule: no context estimator clears +0.02 with a CI-positive delta on either gene
honest_scope: IN-DISTRIBUTION to the Stanford knowledge base; ~96% subtype B.
Leave-one-study-out is the out-of-distribution split, NOT an independent cohort.

The fold labels are right-censored at 100.0 (wiki/hiv_fold_censoring_audit_2026-09-22). The binary label is a threshold at fold >= 3, far below the ceiling, and EVERY estimator sees the identical labels, so censoring cannot favour one arm.
Two genes of ONE virus. A negative here does not generalise to other pathogens.
'Context' here means interactions among substitution tokens. It does NOT test a sequence model over raw residues, which is a different and more expensive question.

The claim is scoped to THIS FEATURE SPACE at THIS SAMPLE SIZE under THIS split. With ~1063 (RT) / 405 (IN) one-hot features and 1883 / 844 blind-spot isolates, added capacity may simply be unaffordable out-of-distribution -- that is a different statement from 'HIV resistance is additive', which this does NOT establish.
It does NOT test a sequence model over raw residues. 'Context' here means interactions among substitution tokens; attention over the raw sequence is a different, costlier question this cannot answer.
named_limitations: PAIR SELECTION IS BY PREVALENCE, which handicaps the pairwise arm. `build_pairs` ranks candidate pairs by co-occurrence among the top-40 most PREVALENT tokens; in an NNRTI cohort of treatment-experienced patients those are dominated by NRTI thymidine-analogue mutations (41L/210W/215Y) and M184V -- real epistatic biology, but NOT efavirenz drivers. So the pairwise delta is a statement about prevalent-token pairs, not about the most PREDICTIVE pairs. The general claim therefore rests on the NON-LINEAR arm, which sees every feature and can form any interaction, and which also lost on both genes.
That the top pairs ARE canonical biology is what makes the negative strong rather than weak: the construction found genuine interactions and they still did not help.
A cheap unexplored follow-up, if anyone wants to push: select pairs by univariate association with the label rather than by prevalence. Not run here.
what_a_negative_licenses: shipping the linear complement as-is, with the floor documented as the measured ceiling for this feature space -- which closes candidate row 5 rather than leaving it open indefinitely. It would NOT license a claim about attention over raw SEQUENCE, which these token features cannot test.
